resources.string: Add or remove trusted HTTPS instance URLs, one per line.
Choose a saved instance. Switching while Invidious is enabled restarts the app.

Send YouTube requests through your instance, including video and images. Direct YouTube requests are blocked. The instance must support the API and proxy media locally. Some YouTube features are unavailable. Changing this setting restarts the app.
HTTPS root URL of an instance you trust. Its operator can see your requests. Changing the instance while enabled restarts the app.
Enter the HTTPS root URL of an Invidious instance, without a path, credentials, query, or fragment.
The Invidious instance returned an unusable media or manifest response. Try again later or choose another trusted instance that supports video proxying.
The selected Invidious instance denied API access (HTTP %1$s). Choose another trusted instance under Settings → Content → Switch Invidious instance.
The selected Invidious instance is rate limiting requests (HTTP %1$s). Try again later or choose another trusted instance under Settings → Content → Switch Invidious instance.
The selected Invidious instance is unavailable (HTTP %1$s). Try again later or choose another trusted instance under Settings → Content → Switch Invidious instance.
The selected Invidious instance rejected the request (HTTP %1$s). Check the instance address or choose another trusted instance under Settings → Content → Switch Invidious instance.
